scope: Global Steam per-server field boss live timestamps

sources.name: Aion2Timers community feed
sources.result: HTML explicitly identifies an automated-access gate; no JSON boss records obtained. No alternate user-agent, proxy or gate bypass attempted.

sources.name: MythosOfs tracker
sources.result: Public README and source describe Aion2Timers feed, 60-second refresh and estimated flags. This is a consumer of the same feed, not an independent source.

sources.name: Grimvane
sources.result: Documented endpoint supplies 48 bosses with location/level/respawn period; API key required. No evidence it supplies a global per-server live kill feed. Personal timers are a separate authenticated endpoint.

sources.name: AbyssLogs
sources.result: Public website and published frontend identify api.abysslogs.com/v1 but inspected frontend has no field-boss or respawn feed endpoint. Meter documentation lists field-boss alerts; no usable public server feed discovered.

sources.name: Gamers4Life
sources.result: Provider documents Discord boss/event commands. No public JSON feed endpoint established; a Discord bot is not evidence of an embeddable live data API.

sources.name: A2Tools public CDN feed
sources.result: Actual JSON received for representative Global IDs 1101,1201,1301,1401,1501. Independent one-minute demand cache, four faction-specific records; no game uploads or collector started. Explicit application User-Agent used. External service guarantee/redistribution grant not established by GPL code license.

sources.name: A2Tools Event Timers reference schedule
sources.result: README and generated schedule.js agree: Rift at server 02:00 then every 3h. Regional clocks specified. Community client-extracted reference, not independently verified official schedule. Independent implementation of schedule facts; no upstream code copied.

requiredEvidence: Provider-supported accessible read endpoint or authorized API access
Real Global server identifiers mapped to our region/server/faction IDs
Boss identity, source timestamp, next-spawn or observed state, estimated flag and freshness semantics
nextAction: Monitor missing/elapsed observations; do not fabricate boss times. Rift defaults now have attributed reference schedule.

coverageCheck.scope: One server per faction per region; 10 of 106 servers, 40 boss records
coverageCheck.productionEU1301: HTTP200; all four nextSpawn timestamps present; refreshFailed=false
coverageCheck.limitation: Point-in-time sample. No continuous or all-server completeness guarantee.
